note: Proposed by the chain audit (2026-10-11) but NOT applied: each one is a scholarly judgement rather than a mismatch with the stored text. Break markers between al-Hasan and 'Ubada or Ibn Muharrar and Hittan rest on whether the transmission was possible; restored narrators rest on parallel texts. Move an entry into corrections/hadith-kg.json (replacing any partial entry for the same chain) to accept it.

corrections.reason: Add the inqita between al-Hasan and 'Ubada. al-Hasan did not hear 'Ubada: al-Shafi'i himself says al-Hasan used to put Hittan al-Raqashi between them, and the dataset already marks this exact route (al-Shafi'i < 'Abd al-Wahhab < Yunus < al-Hasan < 'Ubada) with inqita in chains 198333, 340125, 383381 and 431847.

corrections.reason: Add Ibn 'Asakir (record 46607) as collector, and restore al-Hasan between al-Fadl b. Dalham and Qabisa: al-Fadl (t7) cannot have heard Qabisa (t3, d. 67), and every other copy of this Waki' < al-Fadl isnad has al-Hasan, including Ibn al-Jawzi's quotation through the same Hibat Allah < Ibn al-Mudhhib < al-Qati'i < 'Abd Allah route (chain 421702) and Musnad Ahmad 15592 itself. The al-Hasan insertion rests on these parallels; the Tarikh Dimashq text as stored omits him. hadith-kg stores no author at pos 0 for this book (pos 0 is always the author's informant), so the chain ends one link short and the informant is treated as the collector.
corrections.evidence: Tarikh Dimashq 52057, hadith-kg hadiths.id 627864: 'قَالَ : وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دَلْهَمٍ ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ'. Musnad Ahmad 15592 (hadiths.id 51766): 'حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دَلْهَمٍ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ'.
corrections.author: claude audit agent (unreviewed)

corrections.reason: 'Abd Allah b. Muharrar (t7, died under al-Mansur) cannot have heard Hittan b. 'Abd Allah (t2, d. 71); at least one link is missing. In hadith-kg his recorded teachers are t3 to t6, most often Qatada (27 chains). The missing person is not named, so mark inqita rather than guess.
